question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**optimistic**" means hopeful and confident about the future. (आशावादी)
 
• In the context of student clubs, these activities develop leadership and social skills in a positive or optimistic way.
 
• The other options:** "pessimistic," "aggressive," and "dominant" do not fit the context as appropriately.**

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *These activities not only benefit in shaping their interests and hobbies but also develop their leadership and social skills in a/an optimistic__ way.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Pessimistic (निराशावादी)**: means tending to see the worst aspect of things or believe the worst will happen.
 
• **Aggressive (आक्रामक)**: means ready or likely to attack or confront.
 
• **Dominant (प्रभावशाली)**: means most important, powerful, or influential.
